title: Pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements
learningObjectives: Choose and write maintainable CSS selectors for pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements.

understand.concept: Pseudo-classes target states or structural conditions, such as :hover and :focus-visible. Pseudo-elements style a part or generated content, such as ::first-letter and ::before.
understand.whyItMatters: Good selectors target intended elements and keep styles maintainable.
understand.analogy: Selectors are like finding items in a list by their labels or relationships.
understand.analogyLimit: Selectors are not just labels; the document tree, state and specificity also matter.

explain.narrative: Pseudo-classes target states or structural conditions, such as :hover and :focus-visible. Pseudo-elements style a part or generated content, such as ::first-letter and ::before.
